fields.title: PPRA-EPMS tender record
fields.description: One record per row/tender. Shape depends on recordType: TENDER_LIST (mode=list, one row from the active-tenders/tenders-history table) or TENDER_DETAIL (mode=detail, a raw label/value passthrough of the tender's own detail page -- field set can vary per tender since PPRA renders some fields conditionally, e.g. Contact Person/Email/Phone, Estimated Cost). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a query/tender fails or is not found.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'latest' or a 'search:...' summary of the filters used. For detail records: the tenderNo or URL that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-listing or S1-detail on success, 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (not_found, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

page.title: Page
page.description: TENDER_LIST only -- which 50-row page this row came from.

tenderNo.title: Tender number
tenderNo.description: PPRA's own tender number, e.g. TS0000012236E.

description.title: Description
description.description: TENDER_LIST only -- short description snippet, if PPRA rendered one for this tender.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: TENDER_LIST only -- raw badge text shown on the listing row (typically the sector and the procuring office's own reference number).

organizationName.title: Organization name
organizationName.description: The government organization/department running this procurement.

officeName.title: Office name
officeName.description: The specific office within the organization.

location.title: Location
location.description: TENDER_LIST only -- raw city/country text as shown on the listing row.

status.title: Status
status.description: TENDER_LIST only -- badge text list, e.g. ['Published'], ['Published', 'Corrigendum'], ['Closed'].

detailUrl.title: Detail URL
detailUrl.description: Link to this tender's full detail page -- feed tenderNo into a mode=detail run for the full picture.

invoiceUrl.title: Invoice URL
invoiceUrl.description: Link to PPRA's own publication-fee invoice page for this tender (not fetched by this actor -- a minor bonus data point, the fee PPRA charges the procuring office to publish, not a bid/tender financial figure).

contactPerson.title: Contact person
contactPerson.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- present only when the procuring office filled it in.

contactEmail.title: Contact email
contactEmail.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- present only when the procuring office filled it in.

contactPhone.title: Contact phone
contactPhone.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- present only when the procuring office filled it in.

tenderType.title: Tender type
tenderType.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- e.g. Request for Proposal (RFP).

tenderNoReferenceNoTenderInquiryNo.title: Tender/reference/inquiry number
tenderNoReferenceNoTenderInquiryNo.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- the procuring office's own reference number (distinct from PPRA's own tenderNo).

procurementCategory.title: Procurement category
procurementCategory.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- e.g. Goods, Works, Consultancy Services.

procurementProcedure.title: Procurement procedure
procurementProcedure.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- e.g. Single Stage-Two Envelope.

closingDateAndTime.title: Closing date & time
closingDateAndTime.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- combined text, e.g. 'September 14, 2026 at 11:00 AM'.

openingTime.title: Opening time
openingTime.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- present only when set.

bidSecurity.title: Bid security
bidSecurity.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- amount in PKR, present only when set.

workflowType.title: Workflow type
workflowType.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- e.g. Standard Evaluation Process.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
